title.zh: 【PantherTrade、HashKey、EX.IO 加入香港金管局 EnsembleTX 项目】
title.en: 【PantherTrade、HashKey、EX.IO 加入香港金管局 EnsembleTX 项目】

current_state.zh: PantherTrade, HashKey, and EX.IO joined Hong Kong's HKMA EnsembleTX project, with PantherTrade completing a real-money tokenized deposit transaction to buy tokenized money market fund shares and Standard Chartered providing tokenized deposit and CBDC-based settlement.
